dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, ordering, mutual exclusion, and format conflict are implemented, but help lacks the required realistic repeated-field example.
evidence: product.diff: item-list flag and RunE hunks

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name resolution uses EqualFold, preserves canonical returned names for headers, and produces sorted actionable name/ID candidates; ambiguous IDs are sorted.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields and ResolveFieldByName sorting hunk

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Selected fields reuse definitions from the item query, fetch subsequent field pages only when requested, and return retrieval errors before rendering.
evidence: tests.log: focused Go test command passed

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All requested scalar and structured types render through ID-matched values, but carriage returns are replaced with spaces rather than removed.
evidence: tests.log: focused Go test command passed

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: The command resolves selected fields before output, appends canonical headers in request order, and maps each row by field ID with empty missing cells.
evidence: tests.log: focused Go test command passed

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolution and pagination errors return before table rendering; the patch extends existing query and table helpers without changing no-field output flow.

criticalGaps: Help does not include a realistic repeated --field/--field-id example.
CR characters are converted to spaces instead of being removed.
